title: In vitro cultivation of adherent cells on microscope slides for downstream applications
author: Samset Hoem, Lillerovde Ørstenvik, et al.

steps.title: Set cell seeding density
steps.instruction: Choose the appropriate cell concentration for each cell line before seeding onto the microscope slides: 500 000 cells / mL for A549, 1 000 000 cells / mL for ASK, and 1 400 000 cells / mL for RT‑gillW1, aiming for a confluent monolayer.

steps.title: Homogenize cell suspension
steps.instruction: Thoroughly mix the cell suspension to achieve a uniform suspension, then pipette the calculated volume onto each slide to seed the cells.

steps.title: Wash slides to remove serum
steps.instruction: After the cells have adhered and before any histological staining, rinse each slide repeatedly with appropriate buffer to eliminate all fetal bovine serum (FBS) that could bind dyes.
